title: WFE Uni-Match electric water feeder: fails to feed water
equipment: McDonnell & Miller Series WFE Uni-Match electric water feeder

n1.text: Ask the tech to recheck all wiring against the instructions. Is the wiring correct?

r_wire.cause: Wiring does not match the instructions.
fix: Correct the wiring as specified in the manual, then retest.

n2.text: Ask the tech to check the integral strainer. Is it clean?

fix: Have the tech clean the strainer of debris and sediment, then retest.

n3.text: Do the low water cut-off controls connected to the feeder work correctly?

r_lwco.cause: The connected low water cut-off is not operating correctly, so the feeder may not be permitted to feed.
fix: Have the tech check the low water cut-off controls and correct or replace as needed. Never bypass them.

r_esc.cause: The manual lists only these three checks and all passed.
fix: Escalate to McDonnell & Miller or the Xylem support line with model, wiring photos and what was checked.
